Generated 2026-05-06T18:51:13Z. This is the classic-style view over the current 4B and 8B training runs. It uses the same durable rollout trace artifacts as the older runtime viewers: timeline_events.json for stage timing and trace.json/actions[*].execution_time for helper-backed search-call latency.

The source-alignment plots compare actual local/web search calls against the expected hop source from the final dataset pattern and hop document ids.

Raw exports

  • trace_stage_timings.csv: every parsed timeline stage event.
  • trace_rollout_timings.csv: rollout-level timing, search/doc counts, and source-alignment aggregates.
  • trace_helper_actions.csv: helper-backed web/local search action execution times, queries, and top result summaries.
  • trace_error_summary.csv: error summaries and emitted trace error records.
